title: Recent records made in Hamburg and England with Keith Smith
summary: Purnell says he recorded in England with almost the same band, with English trumpeter Keith Smith, and the record is now out in America.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: I got a record of yours that was made in Hamburg with Jimmy Archie and Darnell Howard and the rest. Have you made any since then?
Yeah, we made some records in England, too. We just got them here in America, and I think they were some of the greatest records we made.
Who you got with you on it?
Well, almost the same band, just about the same band. The only difference in the band is that the one in English boy, Keith Smith, is playing trumpet on it.
Those English boys play a mighty fine hunk of jazz sometimes.
Yeah, Keith Smith is very good. He's been out of New Orleans listening to the jazz and learning everything he could, and I think he's really improved. I think it's doing him good.
I'm just wondering, is the record out now?
Yeah, the record's out now. I think Bill Basin has some.
